claim_policy.score_denominator: Only task instances that pass task qualification, evidence qualification and independent-oracle admission may enter a capability resolution denominator. Invalid or unresolved cases are reported separately, never silently dropped.
superiority_claim_requires: same benchmark version and task split
same task instructions, source snapshot and oracle semantics
same primary metric and aggregation rule
matched model, harness, tools, prompt, turns, tokens, time, compute and cost budgets, or a preregistered controlled ablation
at least three independent seeds, with five where pilot variance warrants it
paired confidence interval or preregistered non-inferiority test
task-level outcomes, unresolved cases, exclusions and raw denominators
independent pristine regrade and exact evidence digests
public disclosure of deviations and protocol version
claim_policy.contextual_comparison_rule: A published result with different tasks, metric definitions, budget, harness or rubric is a contextual reference only. It can motivate a target but cannot support a beat-SOTA claim.
claim_policy.aggregation_rule: Do not collapse resolution, security, evaluator integrity, calibration, cost, human review and unresolved states into one weighted score. Report each axis. Critical hard-gate failures cannot be compensated by another metric.
claim_policy.benchmark_lifecycle_rule: Version task, instruction, environment, budget, grader and scoring changes. Breaking changes require reruns; verifier semantic changes require regrade; metadata-only changes may reuse prior results only when execution and scoring bytes are unchanged.
